title: Try the IRC front end with real clients (irssi, WeeChat, HexChat)
description: The v1 tests use a raw-TCP client. Still unverified against real clients (docs/irc-lessons.md *unverified* items): hostmask read from 001's last word; autojoin waiting for 376/422; irssi matching the PONG last parameter; WHO #c on join; a CAP/NICK/USER/REQ/END burst losing CAP END; how own messages sent from JMAP look without echo-message. Connect: irssi /connect -password <token> 127.0.0.1 6667; WeeChat irc.server.<name>.password; HexChat server password. Token: <state_dir>/agent-token. Record findings in docs/irc-lessons.md.
close_reason: Checked with irssi 1.4.3 driven via tmux (a712980, docs/irc-lessons.md). WeeChat/HexChat not tried; findings filed.
